leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a binary search algorithm to efficiently locate the first bad version
Initialize and manipulate version boundaries to track search ranges
Apply conditional logic to determine when to update search boundaries
Construct a solution that returns the exact index of the first bad version
Configure the algorithm to handle edge cases like single-element arrays
Integrate a provided isBadVersion API into the search logic
Control loop execution to minimize API calls while maintaining correctness
